// Part: room: butler's pantry (interior: service pantry and passage to the kitchen).
// A cooper's store: barrels along the west wall, a potted-shelf row, a work counter with cauldron, smoker and anvil at the
// south-east end (the focal piece, seen from the north door), and standing lanterns on the barrels and the counter.
// Inner air x52..60 z54..60, floor row y4. Lanes kept clear: north door (56,54), east doors (60,56..57), south doors (52..55,60).
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

const ORIGIN = [52, 4, 54];

const LEGEND = {
  B: ["barrel", { facing: "up", open: "false" }],
  S: ["chest", { facing: "south" }],
  P: "dark_oak_planks",
  C: "cauldron",
  K: ["smoker", { facing: "north" }],
  A: ["anvil", { facing: "east" }],
  T: "flower_pot",
  L: ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }],
};

// y4: floor-level furniture. Rows z54..z60, columns x52..x60.
const FLOOR = [
  "BBL...SS.", // z54: barrels on the west wall, a lantern on the floor, chest dresser at the north-east
  "B........", // z55: barrel, lantern on top
  "B........", // z56: barrel
  ".........", // z57: east-west lane
  ".....PPPP", // z58: work counter (focal), south-east
  ".....PPPP", // z59: counter, second course
  "........B", // z60: barrel at the south-east corner
];

// y5: things standing on the furniture's top faces.
const TOPS = [
  "T........", // z54: pot on a barrel
  "L........", // z55: standing lantern on a barrel (the room's light)
  "T........", // z56: pot on a barrel
  ".........",
  ".....C.KA", // z58: cauldron, smoker, anvil on the counter
  ".....L...", // z59: lantern on the counter
  "........T", // z60: pot on the corner barrel
];

const HOLD_LAYOUT = true;

export function build(g) {
  if (!HOLD_LAYOUT) layers(g, ORIGIN, LEGEND, [FLOOR, TOPS]);
}

room-9.mjs is restored byte-identical, and make.sh rebuilt build.nbt from it.
left: BLOCKER (not the lamplighter's to fix): the pantry is dark in the real build. parts/shell.mjs line 27 fills the whole main-block interior with air, and runParts locks every cell an earlier part wrote, air included. So room-9's layout and any lamp are refused (probe: 1 lantern refused at 56,4,60). HOLD_LAYOUT=true also keeps the furniture out, so the room places 0 blocks. Fix needed upstream: the shell leaves room interiors unwritten (or runParts lets later parts replace shell air). Then the designer sets HOLD_LAYOUT=false.

Re-run ./make.sh and `mcd room ... --only "butler's pantry"`: expect OK, min 8, 0 dark. If the floor lantern (54,4,54) is dropped, min stays 8, so the designer may remove it. The barrel and counter lanterns must stay (min falls to 6 and 1 without them).
The pantry's room check exits 1 now (NEEDS WORK, all 63 cells dark). That's expected while the layout is held and does not come from a lamp I left out.
Upper floor: the shell's y10 floor is solid over the pantry, so a hanging lantern would have a support, but none is needed for min 8. No hanging lantern added.

structured_output.summary:
Pantry lighting measured, not yet placed: stamped into a scratch copy, the designer's layout with its 3 standing lanterns gives min 8, 0 dark cells. The counter lantern (57,5,59) and barrel lantern (52,5,55) carry the light; the floor lantern (54,4,54) is redundant; no hanging lanterns needed.
In the real build.nbt the pantry is still 63/63 dark (min 0): HOLD_LAYOUT keeps the furniture out, and the shell's air fill locks the room, so a lamp write is refused (probe: refused at 56,4,60).
room-9.mjs is restored byte-identical, and make.sh rebuilt build.nbt from it.
left: BLOCKER (not the lamplighter's to fix): the pantry is dark in the real build. parts/shell.mjs line 27 fills the whole main-block interior with air, and runParts locks every cell an earlier part wrote, air included. So room-9's layout and any lamp are refused (probe: 1 lantern refused at 56,4,60). HOLD_LAYOUT=true also keeps the furniture out, so the room places 0 blocks. Fix needed upstream: the shell leaves room interiors unwritten (or runParts lets later parts replace shell air). Then the designer sets HOLD_LAYOUT=false.

Once unlocked, the designer's FLOOR/TOPS layout already contains the lanterns (52,5,55), (57,5,59) and (54,4,54). Re-run ./make.sh and `mcd room ... --only "butler's pantry"`: expect OK, min 8, 0 dark. If the floor lantern (54,4,54) is dropped, min stays 8, so the designer may remove it. The barrel and counter lanterns must stay (min falls to 6 and 1 without them).
The pantry's room check exits 1 now (NEEDS WORK, all 63 cells dark). That's expected while the layout is held and does not come from a lamp I left out.
Upper floor: the shell's y10 floor is solid over the pantry, so a hanging lantern would have a support, but none is needed for min 8. No hanging lantern added.
No changes were made to room-9.mjs; the probe edit was reverted and checked with diff. Scratch files are in /tmp/lamp-scratch, outside the crew directory.
